purpose: Authoritative front-facing linework plates for eye / brow / eyelid / nostril placement

color_legend.yellow: UPPER eyelid margin  AND (lower on the face) the nostril rims
color_legend.note: yellow means two different features. They are separated by the widest gap in their own vertical spread, never by a hardcoded row. Pure #00FF00 in the border band is the registration mark burned in by annotation_base.py, not a drawn mark.

plates.camera: orthographic, aligned to his measured head frame; the exact basis and framing are reproduced by tools/character/face_plate.py, and the registration marks prove the returned plate was not cropped or rescaled
world-front ortho on an earlier plate; kept as reference, NOT invertible (the head rests pitched ~32.6 deg back, so this view is from below)

agent_instruction: Do not claim these plates are missing. This directory + index is the discoverability surface. Use these before any facial measurement or Blender facial authority work.

finding.headline: MediaPipe's FaceLandmarker misfits THIS face by one feature vertically.
finding.measured: Run directly on the clean plate: its eyebrow ring lands on his EYES, its eyelid rings land on his CHEEKS, its nose_alar ring lands on his UPPER LIP.
finding.consequence: renders/_rig_measure/canonical_fit.json was built from those landmarks, so it inherits the same error -- and reported a 0.0000 mm residual while doing so, because a perfect warp onto anchors that sit on the wrong features is a perfect fit to the wrong question.
finding.authority: These owner-drawn plates supersede canonical_fit.json for eyelid, eyebrow and nostril placement. OWNER LAW #5: what he draws is the observation.
